thread:
maria_g: Received EU DSAR erase request (case EU-1172). User requests embeddings + chat logs removal. Legal flagged a potential retention exception for an ongoing regulator inquiry. Need keystore snapshot handling plan. @legal-team
legal-team: We have identity proof and opened hold RID-1172. Hold likely 48h. Prepare proof of deletion plan; do NOT delete while hold active.
raj_patel: Actionable checklist please: freeze writes, get snapshot list, create timebound keystore role, perform rewrap to ephemeral key, run verification to produce signed proof JSON, upload proof to secure bucket, attach audit logs.
sophie: Confirming snapshots: snap-eu-1172 (eu-west1, KMS key projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/key-main), and mirror in us-central1. Also an old backfill snapshot flagged as orphaned; that will need manual key reconciliation.
alex_k: For the orphaned snapshot, we may need keystore-admins to perform a key-version migration. Document fallback before touching production.
maria_g: Proposed RBAC: create role ad_hoc:custodian:RID-1172, grant only `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on ephemeral key, timebound 1h, approvers: @sophie + @alex_k. infra-oncall to run commands and attach audit reason.
infra-oncall: I can do that. Will include audit label `reason=DSAR-RID-1172`. Will paste commands and audit link here when done.
infra-oncall: Commands:
```
# create ephemeral HSM key
gcloud kms keys create ephemeral-rid-1172 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
# bind minimal IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-rid-1172 --member=serviceAccount:infra-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rewrap snapshot
keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-1172 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-rid-1172 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
# verify and export proof
keystore verify --snapshot=snap-eu-1172 --proof-out=rid-1172-proof.json
aws s3 cp rid-1172-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/RID-1172/
```
infra-oncall: Rewrap succeeded, proof uploaded. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/rid-1172-grant :lock:  (grant expires in 1h)
maria_g: Verified proof and shared with Legal. Marked snapshot metadata `hold:RID-1172`. No deletion performed.
legal-team: Received proof. Hold remains. Open retention-exception ticket PRIV-1172 for Finance.
raj_patel: Follow-up: add runbook to automate ephemeral-role creation, proof schema (key fingerprint, KMS version, signed timestamp), and orphan-snapshot play.
security-bot: Vault: RID-1172 artifacts saved.
